title: Portfolio
text:
These projects demonstrate how I approach data problems from raw inputs through analysis, modeling, evaluation, and communication.



Machine Learning · Life Sciences

Built a regression workflow to predict pIC50 values for CGRP receptor antagonists using molecular structure data sourced from ChEMBL. Chemical structures were represented with 880 binary fingerprint features, reduced to 133 features through variance-based selection. A tuned Random Forest regressor was deployed in an interactive Streamlit application for exploratory virtual screening.



538 in-vitro bioactivity samples; 430 used for model training.
Evaluated tree-based ensemble approaches and performed multi-stage hyperparameter tuning.
Final Random Forest test performance: R² = 0.815 and RMSE = 0.445 pIC50.
Built a Streamlit application that accepts molecular SMILES strings and returns predicted values.
Documented intended use and limitations to distinguish exploratory screening from clinical or therapeutic decision-making.

Technologies: Python, Pandas, scikit-learn, molecular fingerprints, ChEMBL, Streamlit, Git/GitHub
GitHub Repository Live Streamlit App





Analytics Engineering · SQL · Business Intelligence

Built an end-to-end analytics workflow using retail sales data. The project begins with Python-based validation and preprocessing, moves into DuckDB for feature engineering and SQL analysis, and then carries the resulting analytical model into Power BI for dimensional modeling, DAX measures, and dashboard development.



Validated data types, business rules, dates, discounts, quantities, category relationships, and identifiers.
Engineered analytical features including fulfillment time, profit margin, customer lifetime sales, customer span, and customer tiers.
Used SQL to analyze customer, geographic, product, profitability, shipping, and time-based performance.
Built a star-schema model in Power BI with reusable DAX measures.
Developed an executive dashboard around approximately $2.30M in sales, $286K in profit, and 5,009 orders.
Extended the project into statistical modeling with multiple linear regression.

Technologies: Python, Pandas, DuckDB, SQL, Power BI, DAX, dimensional modeling, regression, Git/GitHub
GitHub Repository





Cloud Data Engineering · Machine Learning — In Development

A healthcare-focused portfolio project designed to demonstrate a modern data platform workflow across data lake, warehouse, transformation, analytics, and machine learning layers. The project is being developed with careful attention to data-use restrictions and reproducibility.
Planned technologies: AWS S3, Redshift, SQL, Python, PyTorch, analytics engineering

title: Services
text:
Geiger Data Solutions is a small independent data practice focused on clear analysis, reproducible workflows, and useful deliverables. Engagements can range from focused analytical support to complete reporting and modeling workflows.



Explore datasets, define useful metrics, identify trends, and answer business or research questions using Python and SQL.
Typical work: exploratory analysis, KPI development, segmentation, trend analysis, data validation, SQL reporting.



Transform analytical results into clear dashboards and decision-ready reporting for technical and non-technical audiences.
Tools: Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Python visualization.



Clean, validate, restructure, and document data so that downstream analysis is more reliable and repeatable.
Typical work: data cleaning, feature engineering, ETL/ELT workflows, analytical datasets, dimensional models.



Build and evaluate predictive models when the available data and business question support a machine-learning approach.
Typical work: regression, classification, feature engineering, model comparison, evaluation, lightweight deployment.




My background is especially relevant to healthcare, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, scientific, and research-oriented data, while my analytics work also applies broadly to operational and business datasets.



I favor straightforward solutions that can be explained, reproduced, and maintained. That means documenting assumptions, checking data quality before modeling, choosing tools based on the problem rather than the buzzword, and communicating both results and limitations.



If you have a dataset, reporting need, or analytical question and want to see whether I can help, get in touch.

title: About
text:
Data Scientist · Pharmaceutical R&D Background · Founder, Geiger Data Solutions
I am a data scientist whose path into the field grew out of the life sciences. My academic background in human physiology and biochemistry, combined with professional experience in pharmaceutical R&D, shaped my interest in using computation and data to answer scientific questions.
That interest led me to complete an M.S. in Data Science at Eastern University in 2025. My work now spans data analysis, SQL, machine learning, business intelligence, and cloud technologies, with a particular interest in healthcare and life-sciences applications.
Before moving more deeply into data science, I worked in R&D at AstraZeneca in Inhalation Product Development, where I gained experience in a regulated pharmaceutical environment. Seeing how computational methods and AI were increasingly being applied to drug discovery was one of the major influences behind my decision to pursue graduate training in data science.
